ideas.name: Dividend Payment Price Pressure
ideas.claim: Higher aggregate dividend payment yields are associated with higher daily market returns across an international sample that includes Japan and European countries. The paper attributes the effect to dividend reinvestment flows.
ideas.quote: A one standard deviation increase in payment (0.000389) predicts higher returns in column 2 by 1.2 b.p.

rules.market: International stock markets, including Japan and European countries; the reported effect is pooled across markets
rules.filters: At least 100 stocks with prices in a market on a given day

ideas.claimed_result: In the international sample, a one-standard-deviation increase in dividend payment yield predicted a 1.2 basis-point higher return in the cited regression; data covered 1986–2017.
